questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How crisps are made in large factories
Why crisps are so bad for your teeth
Why people in many countries love crisps
How to make guacamole to eat with crisps
questions.why: They ask why we love crisps and visit two countries in love with crispy snacks.

questions.q: What are Neil's and Beth's favourite crisp flavours?
options: They both like salt and vinegar
Beth likes prawn cocktail and Neil likes salt and vinegar
Neil likes prawn cocktail and Beth likes cheese
Beth doesn't like crisps at all
questions.why: Beth's favourite is prawn cocktail, and Neil's is salt and vinegar.

questions.q: Why does Neil say crisps are not the healthiest food?
options: They contain a lot of sugar
They are made from corn
They are eaten too late at night
They have lots of oil and salt
questions.why: Neil says with lots of oil and salt, they're not the healthiest food.

questions.q: According to Mitchell Dingwall, what is the best thing about crisps?
options: The crunch and the salty taste
The many different shapes
The low price
The colourful packets
questions.why: He says 'You can't beat the crunch' and the delicious, salty feeling.

questions.q: What does Mitchell mean when he talks about a 'snowball effect'?
options: Crisps taste best when eaten in winter
Crisp sales keep growing every single year
Crisps go soft quickly once you open them
Once you start eating crisps, you can't stop
questions.why: He says you just want more; Neil explains you eat one and soon the whole packet's gone.

questions.q: What does Jolene Ng say about crisps in the UK?
options: They are only eaten at parties and celebrations
They are much less popular than in Singapore
They're a normal part of life, even in sandwiches
They are mainly eaten by young children
questions.why: She says they're part and parcel of life in the UK; her husband even puts them in his sandwich.

questions.q: What do people in Mexico usually eat instead of potato chips?
options: Tortilla corn chips
Fried bananas
Rice crackers
Popcorn
questions.why: Beth says in Mexico tortilla corn chips are eaten instead of potato chips.

questions.q: Why does Jenny Martinez prefer tortilla chips?
options: They are healthier
You can dip them in almost anything
They are cheaper than potato chips
They stay fresh for longer
questions.why: She says you could dip it in almost everything, like guacamole or salsa.
